**Key Facts [HIGH confidence — multiple sources]:**
- October 1, 2026 is the deadline for Duren to accept/reject the qualifying offer

- Pistons removed the weight clause (latest concession); original sticking point
- Duren's eligible max: 5 years / ~$287 million under the Rose Rule (third-team All-NBA)
- Gap between Pistons offer and max eligibility: ~$87 million
- Qualifying offer value: $9.6 million
- If Duren signs QO: he becomes unrestricted FA in 2027; Pistons lose matching rights
- Deadline can be extended to March 1, 2027 if both sides agree deal is close
- Duren is 22 years old; first All-Star selection; third-team All-NBA 2025-26
- Duren stats: 19.5 pts, 10.5 reb per game (2025-26)
- Duren absent from media day and training camp start
**Freshness:** Multiple sources from September 2026; deadline is today. HIGH freshness.
**Why it matters:** Most consequential contract decision of the 2026-27 offseason.
